about.intro: I am a second-year PhD researcher and teaching assistant at the National School of Applied Sciences (ENSA) of Khouribga, Sultan Moulay Slimane University, conducting my research at the LaSTI Laboratory under the supervision of Professor Nouredine Gherabi. My doctoral research focuses on the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and databases, and is generously supported by a CNRST scholarship. Before transitioning to full-time research, I trained as a software engineer—a background that still shapes how I approach problems today: rigorous about theoretical ideas, yet practical about building robust systems.
about.philosophy: A Berber proverb my family raised me on: be like an onion — it keeps growing in almost any condition, even without soil. That's how I try to learn: in the lab, in the classroom, and in whatever new field pulls my curiosity next.

activities.title: FRTN Technologies Incubation Program
activities.description:
I was thrilled to be accepted into the FRTN Technologies Startup Incubation Program, an experience that deepened my passion for the startup world even more 🤍🤍.

During this intensive program, I worked on developing my entrepreneurial mindset and business acumen. Key focus areas and accomplishments included:

Entrepreneurial Incubation: Gained hands-on training in startup creation and scaling (Programme d'incubation des entrepreneurs & Startup).

Business Strategy: Mastered the Business Model Canvas (BMC), Business Planning, Pitching, and building compelling Pitch Decks (including a 90-second fast pitch deck).

Product & Tech: Built landing pages utilizing NoCode tools and analyzed user traction and early adopters.

Professional Branding: Developed skills in personal branding, copywriting, and adopting an entrepreneurial mindset and vision.

Market Analysis: Studied failure cases and built a comprehensive glossary of startup terminology.

This experience significantly accelerated my growth in the business world, and my current goal is to keep learning, building, and developing these skills further!

activities.title: Odyssées Régional
activities.description:
During my second year, I decided to participate in the "Odyssées Régionales" at ENSAK. I worked with a wonderful team on the "2ST" project 🤍.
During the 2ST project pitch, I even got the chance to meet more creative and wonderful people. For this project, we focused on smart vehicle safety technology, where we suggested an innovative system to help prevent car accidents.
